retrievalProfile.description: An extreme close-up portrait of a male subject with a shallow depth of field, featuring distressed, layered typography in the lower corner.
triggerTerms: warm skin tones with dark background

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate headshot of a man with blonde hair and light eyes, where the face occupies the majority of the frame. The lighting is soft and warm, focusing on the eyes and stubble, while the background is a deep, out-of-focus dark tone. Text is anchored in the bottom left, using a rugged, stamped aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's eyes serve as the primary focal point, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
The warm, golden tones of the hair and skin contrast sharply with the dark, shadowed background.
The distressed red and white typography provides a tactile, gritty counterpoint to the smooth skin textures.
The diagonal flow of the hair creates a sense of movement across the upper half of the frame.
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up cropping that cuts off the top of the head.
Visible facial stubble and skin texture detail.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and scaled to fill approximately 85% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's right eye (viewer's left) acts as the central anchor point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the mouth and stubble, and finally rests on the high-contrast text in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, restricted to the dark areas behind the neck and hair on the left side.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and gold (skin and hair).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the center (face) tapering to low value at the edges; high saturation in the red text.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens in the skin tones
Maintain high contrast between text and background

letterConstructionRules: Blocky, thick strokes with minimal modulation
Intentional 'stamped' or 'weathered' texture applied to edges
Irregular baseline for a hand-applied feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded edges on the 'A' and 'R' characters
Slightly rounded corners to simulate ink bleed
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same family, different color and scale for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed skeleton and blocky feel.
Provides the necessary weathered texture and uppercase structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up photograph of a man with blonde hair and light eyes, focusing on skin texture and stubble. Use shallow depth of field with a dark, out-of-focus background. Ensure the lighting is warm and directional from the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase, distressed sans-serif text in the bottom left corner. The top line should be red and larger; the bottom line should be white and slightly smaller. Apply a stamped, eroded texture to both.

verificationChecks: Is the face the dominant element filling the frame?
Is the text in the bottom left corner distressed?
Is the color palette primarily warm skin tones against black?
Are the eyes in sharp focus?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is legible despite the distress effect.
Ensure the crop is tight enough to cut the top of the head.
Confirm the red text is more prominent than the white text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + warm directional lighting + dark negative space + bottom-aligned distressed sans-serif typography.
